rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home structure, flooring, and contents caused by a burst internal plumbing line is direct property damage covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel returned from a work trip to find approximately two inches of standing water throughout the basement caused by a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that leaked for roughly two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot, and numerous ruined stored boxes. Estimated damage likely exceeds $25,000.

case_facts.damage_description: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.discovery_context: policyholder returned from work trip and found basement flooded
case_facts.source_of_water: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days
